issues.quote: net income grew 31.1% to $77.7 billion in fiscal 2025 versus $54.3 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Amazon's fiscal 2024 net income was about $59.2 billion, not $54.3 billion. Growth from $59.2B to $77.7B is about 31.2%, which matches the stated rate. Using $54.3B would imply about 43.1% growth, so the analysis contradicts itself.

data.summary: Revenue growth, gross margin, operating margin and EPS all check out. The fiscal 2024 net income figure ($54.3B) is wrong: the reported figure was about $59.2B, and $54.3B doesn't match the stated 31.1% growth.
